script.spoken: Only one XB-70 remains, in a museum. In a photo formation, an F-104 fighter collided with the giant XB-70 bomber. Both aircraft crashed, and two pilots were killed. Five jets were flying in close formation. They were being photographed for their engine maker. The F-104 drifted into the bomber's wing. It rolled over the XB-70 and exploded. The Valkyrie lost its tail and crashed.
